infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Breadcrumb shows where you are on the map while you use it, so you can find trails and stops near you. Your location stays on your phone.

plugins.photosPermission: Breadcrumb uses your photo library so you can add photos of the places on a trail.
plugins.cameraPermission: Breadcrumb uses the camera so you can take photos of the places on a trail.
